_note: Config for python/visual_pick.py (camera mounted on top of the gripper). Servo channels, types and gripper angles come from pick_place_config.json. Offsets are degrees away from the neutral pose.
_note_pose: neutral = the inverted L; offsets and tip height are measured from it. start = where the test begins and ends; keep it equal to the Standby button in servo_control_app.py.
_note_rest: rest_servo_deg: servo angles (as in servo_control_app.py) for the raised rest pose used after a run and when the program is stopped.

directions._note: Filled in by: python visual_pick.py --direction-test. --execute refuses to run until confirmed is true.
directions._note_image: image_upright false rotates every camera frame 180 degrees. Set false on 2026-11-10: with the USB camera both image axes moved the wrong way while aiming.

detection._note_box: Without a colour to confirm it, a YOLO box covering more of the frame than this is ignored. A class with a colour takes its position from the colour blob.
detection._note_position: position_source yolo: the object position is the centre of the YOLO box, ((x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2), and YOLO runs on every look while aiming (about 0.7 s each). The colour must still agree under that centre. Boxes larger than max_box_area_frac fall back to the colour blob centre. color: the colour blob gives the position and YOLO only confirms once. --color objects (HC-SR04 in the dashboard) never use YOLO.

color._note: --color finds the object by HSV colour instead of YOLO. circles: the class is found as two same-size circles side by side on a board whose colour (board_hsv_low/high) covers at least board_min_cover of the box around them; the position is their midpoint. Measured on the USB camera, where the HC-SR04 board looks pale blue (S down to about 20).

approach._note_search: Until the object is seen, step down this much per look, pause so the slow camera gets a still frame, and start over from the top at the bottom of the sweep.
approach._note_target: target_u_frac, target_v_frac: the image centre, so an aimed object sits under the lens. The arm then moves out by gripper_offset_mm, the measured lens to gripper centre distance.
approach._note_commit: After commit_detections sightings the arm turns once and goes down blind to align_tip_mm, moves out by gripper_offset_mm (the jaws sit behind the camera), then straight down to grip_tip_mm. base_deg_per_u: base degrees per image width.
approach._note_aim: Aiming (aim_before_pick true): each look turns the base and slides the camera together, aim_turn_frac of the base error and aim_gain_deg per image height, then waits aim_settle_s. base_deg_per_u 40 comes from a run where 10.8 degrees moved the object 0.28 of the image width.
approach._note_base_offset: base_offset_deg: added to the single base turn before going down (positive turns right, about 3 degrees per cm at the grip reach of about 187 mm). 2026-11-10: -6.1 after a 2 cm right miss; with YOLO box centres the jaws landed 1 cm left (-> -3.0), then 1 cm left again (-> 0.1).
approach._note_precision: Accuracy (2026-11-10): aim roughly (aim_deadband 6%), then take commit_detections looks without moving and go down on their average, which smooths YOLO's box jitter. The leftover error is corrected while going down: across with base_deg_per_u, and out/back with mm_per_image_height (an estimate: 140 mm of table per image height at the aiming height; if the jaws land consistently short or long, tune gripper_offset_mm first).
approach._note_teach: target_u_frac / target_v_frac per object come from --teach: the image position of the object when it is centred between the jaws, seen from the aiming pose. final_descent_deg_per_s: speed of the last move down onto the object.

limits._note: Travel from the neutral pose. min_tip_height_mm uses the estimated link lengths and the wrist pitch from hold_servo_deg.
limits._note_offset: tip_offset_mm: measured 80 mm at the table when the estimate said 44 mm, so all heights are real table heights from one measured point.

auto._note: --auto: after lifting, carry the object to the destination marker (aruco.tray_marker_id). Stops after max_sweeps sweeps with nothing seen.

place._note: With an object held: go to the start pose, turn through scan_base_deg (offsets from the base neutral), then the next row, which lowers shoulder and elbow by that many degrees. Aim as for an object but stay above carry_tip_mm, move out by gripper_offset_mm at drop_tip_mm, then release.

_note_objects: objects: per-class values laid over approach / limits / place, for objects that are not relay-sized. Heights are real table heights of the gripper tip. bananapi is a 95 mm tall box: search and aim stay above it, the jaws move out over it at align_tip_mm, then grip 25 mm below its top.

bananapi._note: Box 95 mm tall. Gripper opening must fit across the box.

detection._note: Any YOLO bananapi box (the model reports from 0.1) counts once the colour blob under it agrees.

ultrasonic_hc-sr04._note: HC-SR04: found by its two circles (colour only), not by YOLO.
ultrasonic_hc-sr04._note_offset: base_offset_deg: jaws landed about 13 mm left (on the left transducer instead of between the two) on 2026-11-10, so 0.1 + 4.0 deg (13 mm at the 187 mm grip reach).
